hypotheses.justification: Only the proof of hb needs changing. Split on R = 0. If R = 0, div_zero makes baseProfile lam (z.2 / R) constant, so contDiffOn_const proves hb regardless of the value of the real power at zero. Otherwise, div_ne_zero hz.2.ne' hR0 replaces (div_pos hz.2 hR).ne'; Real.contDiffAt_rpow_const_of_ne applies to negative inputs too. The proofs of ha', hr, and the final multiplication remain unchanged: division by a constant is smooth even when that constant is zero.
